question.problem:
Suppose we take a random sample of size $n=96$ from a population where $36%$ of the population has a particular characteristic. Find a normal approximation for the probability that less than $28%$ of the sample has the characteristic. You may assume that the population size is significantly larger than the sample size.

*Hint: A table of values of $Φ(z)$ for different values of $z$ are given below, where $Φ(z)$ is the cumulative distribution function for the standard normal distribution.*

| $z$ | $\,0.01\,$ | $\,0.02\,$ | $\,0.03\,$ | $\,0.04\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\,-1.6\,$ | $\,0.0537\,$ | $\,0.0526\,$ | $\,0.0516\,$ | $\,0.0505\,$ |
| $\,-1.5\,$ | $\,0.0655\,$ | $\,0.0643\,$ | $\,0.0630\,$ | $\,0.0618\,$ |
| $\,-1.4\,$ | $\,0.0793\,$ | $\,0.0778\,$ | $\,0.0764\,$ | $\,0.0749\,$ |
question.worked_solution:
Given a population in which a proportion $p$ of the population has a particular characteristic, the sampling distribution of the sample proportion $\overset{^}{\,p}$ can be approximated as

$$
\overset{^}{\,p}∼N(p,\frac{p(1-p)}{n}),
$$

where the sample size $n$ is much smaller than the population size, $np>5,$ and $n(1-p)>5.$

In our case

- the sample size is $n=96,$ and

- the population proportion is $p=0.36.$

Now, since

$$
np=96(0.36)=34.56>5
$$

and

$$
n(1-p)=96(1-0.36)=61.44>5,
$$

and $n=96$ is much smaller than the population size, we can apply the above approximation.

The sampling distribution of the sample proportion, in this case, can be approximated as

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{^}{\,p} & ∼N(p,\frac{p(1-p)}{n}) \\  & ∼N(0.36,\frac{0.36(1-0.36)}{96}) \\  & ∼N(0.36,0.0024).\end{aligned}
$$

The probability we wish to find is
$P(\overset{^}{\,p}<0.28).$
So, we convert $\overset{^}{\,p}$ to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(\overset{^}{\,p}<0.28) & =P(Z<\frac{0.28-0.36}{\sqrt{0.0024}}) \\  & ≈P(Z<-1.63) \\  & =Φ(-1.63).\end{aligned}
$$

From the table, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}Φ(-1.63) & =0.0516.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(\overset{^}{\,p}<0.28) & =Φ(-1.63) \\  & =0.0516.\end{aligned}
$$
